thread:
ops-bot: INCIDENT 1888 — paging: inference-runtime-prod high 5xx rate starting ~2026-03-15T18:44:xxZ. Paged @liam_ops and @matt_sre. Severity: P2 -> potential customer impact.

liam_ops: Acked. I'm jumping in. quick ask: which routes? any error samples?

anne_prod: Observed across /v1/generate and /v1/chat/generate, spikes between 18:44–18:52 UTC. Host metrics: token-level latencies normal, but large number of `internal_server_error` responses. Customer reports: 3 high-volume customers saw ~1-3% request failure rate, several dev keys saw 10+ failures over a minute.

emily_product: FYI: support ticket #5542 from Acme shows aborted generation mid-sequence. They include this trace id: trace-6f8a2.

liam_ops: Logs pulled from s3 for trace-6f8a2 and tail from host inference-34. pastebin: https://logs.redwood.ai/1888/trace-6f8a2 (internal link)

jordan_re: sharing quick log excerpt: ```
[18:44:12] inference-34 model-run error: kernel_init_failed: incompatible-kernel-shim v2.3->v2.4
[18:44:12] inference-34 fallback: attempt route to variant v1.1 -> queued
[18:44:13] inference-34 kv-cache miss: eviction triggered
[18:44:13] inference-34 response 500 id=trace-6f8a2 msg="runtime-exec-exception"
```

liam_ops: Hypotheses: (1) recent kernel shim bump (v2.4) on a subset of nodes causing execution failures; (2) KV cache pressure leading to partial state loss; (3) upstream routing mismatch sending sequences to nodes with incompatible runtime.

matt_sre: I see a deploy was rolled at 18:40UTC that touched kernel-selection logic (deploy-id: deploy-20260315-1840). deploy-bot, can you confirm which instances got the rollout?

deploy-bot: rollout deploy-20260315-1840 => instances: inference-32, inference-34, inference-35 (canary -> partial). Canary completed, autoscaler unchanged.

liam_ops: OK that matches. Immediate mitigation: 1) take inference-34 out of LB (mark draining), 2) route traffic to fallback variant (v1.1) for affected model family, 3) roll back kernel-selection change on canary instances if errors persist. Doing #1+2 now.

anne_prod: Notifying CS for impacted customers. Draft status page blurb: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting text generation routes; we have activated routing to a compatible model variant to mitigate customer impact. More updates in 30m." Thoughts?

emily_product: Short and neutral is good. Add "no data loss" if we're confident (we are — requests failed, not persisted). Suggest include expected next update time.

liam_ops: Update: drained inference-34 at 18:47:05 UTC, routing policy flipped at 18:47:30 UTC -> ~75% of affected traffic moved to v1.1 fallback. Error rate dropped from ~8% -> 1.2% within 120s. Still seeing intermittent 500s for long-seq requests.

jordan_re: I started a focused grep across older logs for kernel_init_failed; found similar but rare failures on 2026-03-08 after a different patch. Flagging possible regression.

matt_sre: I'm going to spool up an isolated test with the v2.4 kernel on a mirrored instance and run synthetic long sequences to reproduce. If repro, will rollback. ETA 10m.

liam_ops: For timeline/ticketing: please add the following entries to incident timeline (chron order):
- 18:40UTC deploy-20260315-1840 kernel-selection change rolled to canary (deploy-bot confirmed)
- 18:44UTC alarms fire for increased 5xx on inference-runtime-prod
- 18:46UTC incident channel opened, oncall paged
- 18:47UTC inference-34 drained from LB
- 18:47:30UTC routing -> fallback variant v1.1 enabled for affected model family
- 18:49UTC partial reduction in errors observed (8% -> 1.2%)
- 18:55UTC continued intermittent failures on long sequences, investigating

emily_product: Stakeholder comms: product leadership + sales ops + CS + legal for high-risk customers. propose notify: @head-product, @sales-ops, @cs-lead, @sec-compliance if any regulated customers affected.

customer-success-bot: Customer impact summary draft: "During 18:44–19:05 UTC, a subset of generation requests returned internal errors. Root cause under investigation; we have implemented routing to a compatible model variant to reduce errors. Some customers may have experienced transient failed requests; no customer data was modified. We'll follow up with a timeline after investigation."

liam_ops: Good. Assignments: anne_prod => post statuspage (copy to #statuspage-drafts); emily_product => callout to sales ops for top-10 customers; matt_sre => reproduce + rollback decision; jordan_re => collect all kernel_init_failed traces and annotate timeline.

anne_prod: Posting statuspage draft to #statuspage-drafts now. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1888/draft

matt_sre: Repro run shows consistent failure for sequences > 4096 tokens when using kernel v2.4 on cuda-RT driver 525.x; v2.3 works fine. Looks like an ABI/dispatch difference. Rolling rollback on canaries to v2.3 now.

deploy-bot: rollback deploy-20260315-1840 -> target inference-32,34,35; rollback start 18:58UTC; monitor health checks.

liam_ops: Observed error rate back down to baseline ~0.1% at 19:04UTC after rollback and routing; closing live mitigation loop. Still capturing logs for RCA.

jordan_re: Collated timeline with raw log pointers and trace IDs, uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incident-1888/artifacts/timeline.jsonl. Added initial hypotheses and evidence tags.

emily_product: Draft statuspage update ready for publish when we have confirmation on RCA and customer list for targeted follow-ups.

anne_prod: Publishing interim status update now (18:50UTC entry), mark as 'mitigated'. Will follow with full RCA.

liam_ops: Handoff to @matt_sre for RCA ownership and follow-up: matt, please capture postmortem timeline and signal any additional customer comms. Oncall handoff scheduled 19:10UTC -> matt is primary, liam will remain as secondary for questions.

matt_sre: Taking over RCA; I'll produce an incident-summary doc with timeline, root cause (kernel shim regression on v2.4), impact quantification (approx 3–5% of gen requests for 18m window, 3 high-volume customers impacted), and remediation plan (pin kernel to v2.3 in auto-rollouts, add canary perf checks for long sequences, add KV-cache pressure alarms). ETA preliminary RCA 2026-03-16 EOD.

liam_ops: Thanks team. Closing the live bridge. If anything else surfaces, reopen thread.

ops-bot: INCIDENT 1888 — bridge closed by liam_ops at 19:10:00 UTC. Postmortem owner: matt_sre.
